option_relations.rationale: IgG4-related rhinosinusitis with concurrent Streptococcus constellatus bacterial rhinosinusitis is a specific type of invasive bacterial rhinosinusitis
IgG4-related disease is a broader class containing IgG4-Related Ophthalmic Disease
IgG4-Related Disease (IgG4-RD) with Orbital/Sinus Involvement is equivalent to IgG4-Related Ophthalmic Disease
Invasive bacterial rhinosinusitis with orbital apex syndrome is equivalent to the leaf disease
